Jess: @here Quick snack poll — who's bringing snacks today? Also fridge Tetris: please label your containers! :tada:
Sam: I can bring banana bread. Will label mine. :banana:
Priya: vote: banana bread :raised_hands: — also kudos to @Alex for fixing the microwave yesterday, legend. :clap:
Alex: lol I just pressed start again, but accepted. :sweat_smile: Label format I'd recommend:
```
Name — MM/DD
```
Marco: I'll bring cookies. Also saw a 'free scooter' note in the lobby — anyone claiming? :eyes:
DevBot: Reminder: lost-and-found items will be cleared Friday. See #help for details. (automated message)
Jess: Oof fridge purge Friday — if you want anything saved, label it 'KEEP - Name' or it'll be donated. :warning:
Sam: noted. anyone want half a loaf before 11? first come first serve :hand:
Priya: I'll take it! :raised_hand_with_fingers_splayed:
Marco: :thumbsup: Also meme of the day: "office plant plotting its escape" (link) — someone please water the succulents
Alex: I watered them last night, except the one on the third shelf. sorry little fern :cry:
Jess: ok poll: react with :one: banana bread, :two: cookies, :three: fruit. results in 30m. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Jess: also tiny PSA — when labeling, please use pen, not tape; tape slides off in that glass drawer. learned the hard way. :sweat_smile:
